Fates Collide

Released May 2, 2016 · 129 cards

Expanded

Fates Collide is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on May 2, 2016. Its main set has 124 cards, plus 5 secret rares numbered beyond the set (129 in total). It includes 100 Pokémon, 27 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

43 illustrators worked on Fates Collide. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (22), Toyste Beach (11), Ryo Ueda (9), kawayoo (4), Kouki Saitou (4), MAHOU (4), Masakazu Fukuda (4), Shin Nagasawa (4).
